title: Documentation support (MEAT) for chronic conditions
question: Which chronic condition, if any, is supported for risk adjustment by this note? Ignore the reason for the visit. Choose 'no code' if none is supported.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for heart failure.

HPI
The patient is a 68-year-old male presenting for a scheduled follow-up regarding chronic systolic heart failure. He reports feeling well today and denies any increased shortness of breath, paroxysmal nocturnal dyspnea, or significant lower extremity edema. He states he has been adherent to his current medication regimen and has not experienced any chest pain or syncope since the last visit.

Medication List
Lisinopril 20mg daily, Carvedilol 12.5mg twice daily, Spironolactone 25mg daily, Furosemide 40mg as needed.

Exam
The patient appears in no acute distress. Vital signs are stable. Heart sounds are regular with an S3. Lungs are clear to auscultation bilaterally. No peripheral edema noted in the lower extremities.

Assessment
1. Chronic systolic heart failure: The patient is currently stable and reports good symptom control.

Plan
1. Chronic systolic heart failure: The plan is to continue the current medication regimen. The patient will monitor for any increase in weight or fluid retention and return in three months for a follow-up evaluation.
explanations: The provider addressed chronic systolic heart failure at this visit, so it is supported: I50.22.

distractors.why: Status plus a plan in the assessment supports the diagnosis.
